zh.name: lifecyclecontrols
zh.caption: 資料生命週期與清理
zh.description: 清理方法依資料風險、媒體能力與驗證結果選擇。

items.title: 使用中的資料
items.body: 防止未授權存取、竄改與服務中斷。

items.title: 儲存、備份與封存
items.body: 控制誰可以存取、如何保存、保存多久。

items.title: 生命週期終點
items.body: 選擇 Clear、Purge、Destroy 等適當處置。

items.title: 驗證與證據
items.body: 驗證清理結果並保存證據，確保後續再利用、報廢或委外回收符合風險要求。

en.name: lifecyclecontrols
en.caption: Data lifecycle and sanitization
en.description: Choose methods using data risk, media capabilities and verified outcomes.

items.title: Data in use
items.body: Prevent unauthorized access, tampering and service disruption.

items.title: Storage, backups and archives
items.body: Control who can access data, how it is retained and for how long.

items.title: End of lifecycle
items.body: Select appropriate disposition, such as Clear, Purge or Destroy.

items.title: Verification and evidence
items.body: Verify sanitization and preserve evidence so subsequent reuse, disposal or outsourced recycling meets risk requirements.

zh.name: controlaxes
zh.caption: 控制措施的三個分類軸
zh.description: 三個軸可同時描述同一項控制，彼此不是先後步驟。 一項控制可能同時具有預防、偵測及其他作用；這些軸不是互斥分類。

items.title: A｜實作形式
items.body: Administrative：政策、制度、人員與程序／Technical：軟體、系統、網路與密碼學／Physical：門禁、保全、機房與實體設備

items.title: B｜控制功能
items.body: Preventive｜預防：降低事件發生機會／Detective｜偵測：發現事件或異常／Corrective｜矯正：修正已發現的問題／Recovery｜復原：恢復必要能力／Deterrent｜嚇阻：降低行為動機／Compensating｜補償：替代或補足其他控制

items.title: C｜保護目標
items.body: Confidentiality（機密性）、Integrity（完整性）、Availability（可用性），以及適用情境下的身分、可追溯性和隱私等要求。

en.name: controlaxes
en.caption: Three axes for classifying controls
en.description: The axes can describe the same control; they are not sequential steps. A control may serve preventive, detective and other functions at once; the axes are not mutually exclusive.

items.title: A | Implementation
items.body: Administrative: policies, rules, people and procedures / Technical: software, systems, networks and cryptography / Physical: entry controls, guards, facilities and physical equipment

items.title: B | Function
items.body: Preventive: reduce the likelihood of incidents / Detective: discover incidents or anomalies / Corrective: fix identified problems / Recovery: restore necessary capabilities / Deterrent: reduce motivation to act / Compensating: replace or supplement other controls

items.title: C | Protection objectives
items.body: Confidentiality, integrity and availability (CIA), plus identity, traceability and privacy requirements where applicable.

zh.name: defenselayers
zh.caption: 四層縱深防禦
zh.description: 外層包覆內層，多層控制共同保護核心資產。 多層防禦旨在避免單一控制失效就造成不可接受的後果；各控制仍須分別驗證有效性。

items.title: 實體與環境
items.body: 門禁、機房與環境保護

items.title: 網路區隔與流量
items.body: 網段、邊界與流量控制

items.title: 端點與身分
items.body: 端點防護、帳號與權限管理

items.title: 關鍵資料與系統
items.body: 加密、驗證、備份與完整性

en.name: defenselayers
en.caption: Four layers of defense in depth
en.description: Outer layers contain inner layers; multiple controls protect core assets. Multiple layers aim to prevent one failed control from causing unacceptable consequences; each control must still be verified for effectiveness.

items.title: Physical and environmental
items.body: Facility access and environmental protection

items.title: Network segmentation and traffic
items.body: Segments, boundaries and traffic controls

items.title: Endpoint and identity
items.body: Endpoint protection, accounts and privileges

items.title: Critical data and systems
items.body: Encryption, authentication, backups and integrity

zh.name: firewallpolicy
zh.caption: IT／OT 防火牆邊界
zh.description: 只有核准且符合政策的流量能通過；Deny 表示阻擋。

items.title: IT 網路
items.body: 企業辦公端點與一般資訊系統。

items.title: 防火牆
items.body: 檢查來源、目的與服務規則

items.title: OT 網路
items.body: 製造設備與工廠作業控制系統。

items.title: Allow｜核准管理
items.body: 符合規則的管理連線允許通過。

items.title: Deny｜未授權直連
items.body: 阻擋未經核准的直接連線。

en.name: firewallpolicy
en.caption: IT/OT firewall boundary
en.description: Only approved policy-compliant traffic passes; Deny means blocked.

items.title: IT network
items.body: Enterprise office endpoints and general information systems.

items.title: Firewall
items.body: Check source, destination and service rules

items.title: OT network
items.body: Manufacturing equipment and factory operational control systems.

items.title: Allow | Approved management
items.body: Permit management connections that match policy.

items.title: Deny | Unauthorized direct access
items.body: Block unapproved direct connections.

zh.name: sanitizationmethods
zh.caption: Clear／Purge／Destroy 比較
zh.description: 三種方法依資料敏感性、媒體及後續用途選擇，並非必須依序執行。

items.title: Clear｜§3.1.1
items.body: 目標：抵抗簡單、非侵入式的資料復原。針對使用者可存取的儲存區域，採用適當的邏輯清理技術。例：對適合的媒體，透過標準讀寫介面覆寫使用者可定址的資料區域。

items.title: Purge｜§3.1.2
items.body: 目標：使先進實驗室復原技術也無法可行地還原目標資料。使用適合媒體的邏輯或實體技術，並保留媒體可能再次使用的能力。例：符合條件的裝置清理指令、Cryptographic Erase。

items.title: Destroy｜§3.1.3
items.body: 目標：使資料無法以先進實驗室技術可行地復原，並讓媒體失去儲存功能。使用符合媒體特性的實體破壞程序。例：適當規格的媒體粉碎、解體或其他核准的銷毀技術。

en.name: sanitizationmethods
en.caption: Clear / Purge / Destroy comparison
en.description: Choose based on sensitivity, media and intended use; these are not mandatory sequential stages.

items.title: Clear | §3.1.1
items.body: Goal: resist simple, non-invasive data recovery. Apply appropriate logical sanitization to user-accessible storage. Example: overwrite user-addressable data through standard read/write interfaces on suitable media.

items.title: Purge | §3.1.2
items.body: Goal: make recovery of target data infeasible even with advanced laboratory techniques. Use logical or physical techniques appropriate to the media, potentially preserving reuse. Examples: qualifying device sanitization commands and Cryptographic Erase.

items.title: Destroy | §3.1.3
items.body: Goal: make recovery with advanced laboratory techniques infeasible and render the media unable to store data. Use media-appropriate physical destruction. Examples: media shredding to suitable specifications, disintegration or other approved destruction techniques.

zh.name: ssdremapping
zh.caption: SSD 邏輯覆寫與 FTL 重新映射
zh.description: 舊 Page A 與新 Page B 是重新映射後並存的狀態，不是 A 再寫入 B 的時間步驟。 實際行為取決於 SSD 控制器、韌體和儲存技術，不代表每次覆寫都會產生完全相同的結果。

items.title: 作業系統
items.body: 要求覆寫邏輯區塊 LBA 100。

items.title: SSD 控制器／FTL
items.body: 將邏輯位址映射至實體快閃記憶體。

items.title: 舊 Page A
items.body: 原本的實體儲存頁面：舊資料可能尚未被實體抹除。

items.title: 新 Page B
items.body: 新的實體儲存頁面：新資料寫入完成。

en.name: ssdremapping
en.caption: SSD logical overwrite and FTL remapping
en.description: Old Page A and new Page B are concurrent remapping outcomes, not an A-to-B sequence. Actual behavior depends on the controller, firmware and storage technology; not every overwrite produces the same result.

items.title: Operating system
items.body: Requests an overwrite of logical block LBA 100.

items.title: SSD controller / FTL
items.body: Maps logical addresses to physical flash memory.

items.title: Old Page A
items.body: Original physical storage page: old data may not yet have been physically erased.

items.title: New Page B
items.body: New physical storage page: the new data write has completed.

zh.name: sanitizationprogram
zh.caption: 媒體清理治理的六步驟
zh.description: 確認保留義務、執行品質與證據，才可完成結案。

items.title: 1｜Identify — 辨識
items.body: 確認媒體序號、擁有者、資料類別、敏感度及所有已知資料副本。

items.title: 2｜Authorize — 授權
items.body: 確認資料保存期限、法律義務、Legal Hold（法律保留）及核准人員。

items.title: 3｜Select — 選擇
items.body: 根據媒體技術、敏感程度、復原威脅及再利用需求，決定 Clear、Purge 或 Destroy。

items.title: 4｜Execute — 執行
items.body: 使用核准工具與程序，記錄操作人員、設備識別資訊及執行結果。

items.title: 5｜Verify / Validate — 確認
items.body: 先確認操作是否成功完成，再判斷該結果是否符合資料機密性所需的保護程度。

items.title: 6｜Document — 紀錄與結案
items.body: 保存清理證明、覆核與核准紀錄，決定媒體可否釋出、再使用或報廢。

en.name: sanitizationprogram
en.caption: Six steps for sanitization governance
en.description: Closure requires retention review, verified execution and evidence.

items.title: 1 | Identify
items.body: Confirm the media serial number, owner, data categories, sensitivity and all known data copies.

items.title: 2 | Authorize
items.body: Confirm retention periods, legal obligations, legal holds and approving personnel.

items.title: 3 | Select
items.body: Choose Clear, Purge or Destroy based on media technology, sensitivity, recovery threats and reuse requirements.

items.title: 4 | Execute
items.body: Use approved tools and procedures; record operators, device identifiers and execution outcomes.

items.title: 5 | Verify and validate
items.body: First verify successful completion; then validate whether the result provides the protection required for data confidentiality.

items.title: 6 | Document and close
items.body: Retain sanitization certificates, review and approval records; decide whether the media may be released, reused or disposed of.

items.body: How is information security risk management performed in detail?

zh.name: riskassessment
zh.caption: 風險評估的三個步驟
zh.description: 評價階段把分析結果與事先建立的準則比較。

items.title: 風險識別
items.body: 找出哪些威脅可能透過哪些弱點，影響哪些重要資產與業務。

items.title: 風險分析
items.body: 估計事件發生的可能性、後果及不確定性，建立風險程度。

items.title: 風險評價
items.body: 把分析結果與事先設定的接受準則比較，決定哪些風險需要優先處理。

en.name: riskassessment
en.caption: Three steps in risk assessment
en.description: Evaluation compares analysis results with established criteria.

items.title: Risk identification
items.body: Identify threats that may exploit vulnerabilities and affect important assets and business activities.

items.title: Risk analysis
items.body: Estimate incident likelihood, consequences and uncertainty to establish the level of risk.

items.title: Risk evaluation
items.body: Compare analysis results with predefined acceptance criteria to decide which risks require priority treatment.

zh.name: riskmatrix
zh.caption: 風險分數教學互動
zh.description: 教學公式：分數 = L × I；L、I 為 1–5 的序位整數，不代表損失倍數。門檻：1–4 低、5–9 中、10–25 高。 這是教學案例設定的門檻，不是 ISO 官方數值。高風險範例應升級審查並優先處理。

items.title: 可能性 L = 3
items.body: 1–5 的序位尺度

items.title: 衝擊 I = 5
items.body: 1–5 的序位尺度

items.title: 3 × 5 = 15／25｜高風險
items.body: 僅為教學門檻；組織應建立自己的風險準則。

en.name: riskmatrix
en.caption: Risk score learning interaction
en.description: Teaching formula: score = L × I. L and I are ordinal integers from 1–5, not loss ratios. Thresholds: 1–4 low, 5–9 medium, 10–25 high. These thresholds are set by this teaching example, not official ISO values. The high-risk example calls for escalated review and priority treatment.

items.title: Likelihood L = 3
items.body: Ordinal scale from 1–5

items.title: Impact I = 5
items.body: Ordinal scale from 1–5

items.title: 3 × 5 = 15 / 25 | High risk
items.body: Illustrative thresholds; organizations define their own risk criteria.

zh.name: pdcacycle
zh.caption: PDCA 持續改善循環
zh.description: 循環：Plan → Do → Check → Act → Plan。此教學模型不將所有條文機械式分割。

items.title: Plan｜規劃
items.body: 範圍、政策、風險與目標。

items.title: Do｜執行
items.body: 控制措施、風險處理。

items.title: Check｜檢查
items.body: 稽核、量測、管理審查。

items.title: Act｜改善
items.body: 矯正、制度更新。

en.name: pdcacycle
en.caption: PDCA continual improvement cycle
en.description: Cycle: Plan → Do → Check → Act → Plan. This teaching model does not mechanically partition every clause.

items.title: Plan
items.body: Scope, policy, risks and objectives.

items.title: Do
items.body: Controls and risk treatment.

items.title: Check
items.body: Audits, measurement and management review.

items.title: Act
items.body: Correction and management system updates.

zh.name: riskgovernance
zh.caption: 整合風險與隱私治理的七步驟
zh.description: 以範圍、證據、處理與持續審查串起治理；各指引角色不同。

items.title: 1｜定義組織與系統範圍
items.body: ISO/IEC 27001 第 4–6 條。

items.title: 2｜建立風險情境與接受準則
items.body: ISO/IEC 27005 第 6–7 條。

items.title: 3｜分析威脅、弱點、可能性與衝擊
items.body: 參考 NIST SP 800-30、OWASP、MITRE ATT&CK。

items.title: 5｜處理計畫與適用性聲明
items.body: ISO/IEC 27001 第 6.1.3 條。

items.title: 6｜處理涉及個人資料的隱私風險
items.body: ISO/IEC 27701 與適用法律。

items.title: 7｜驗證控制、接受剩餘風險、持續審查

en.name: riskgovernance
en.caption: Seven steps for integrated risk and privacy governance
en.description: Connect scope, evidence, treatment and continual review; guidance documents serve different roles.

items.title: 1 | Define organizational and system scope
items.body: ISO/IEC 27001 clauses 4–6.

items.title: 2 | Establish risk context and acceptance criteria
items.body: ISO/IEC 27005 clauses 6–7.

items.title: 3 | Analyze threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood and impact
items.body: Consult NIST SP 800-30, OWASP and MITRE ATT&CK.

items.title: 4 | Determine necessary controls
items.body: ISO/IEC 27002; 27001 clause 6.1.3.

items.title: 5 | Treatment plan and Statement of Applicability
items.body: ISO/IEC 27001 clause 6.1.3.

items.title: 6 | Address privacy risks involving personal data
items.body: ISO/IEC 27701 and applicable law.

items.title: 7 | Verify controls, accept residual risk and review continually
items.body: 27001 clauses 8–10; 27005 clause 10.
